selection_reasoning: These three tasks form a coherent exploration-and-mining sequence. The agent must first locate cyan_stained_glass, which serves as a landmark/waypoint near a structure containing both lime_stained_glass and a dark_oak_door. Finding the cyan glass orients the agent toward the structure, after which they mine the lime stained glass (requiring breaking a glass block), and then mine the dark oak door (requiring breaking a door). The dependency chain is: find cyan_stained_glass → mine lime_stained_glass (the cyan glass is a visual marker leading to the lime glass nearby) → mine dark_oak_door (the door is behind/adjacent to the lime glass wall, so removing the glass reveals or provides access to the door). This creates a logical spatial progression through a built structure.

milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The cyan stained glass panel is centered around (~-2, 2, 5) relative to spawn. The player must navigate near it and face it to demonstrate they've found it. max_distance=16 and facing_tolerance=60 are used as defaults since the glass is visible from moderate distance.

Uses count_in_box_at_most (kind=block) to detect that at least one lime_stained_glass block has been removed from the front wall. The original wall has 9 lime glass blocks at x=-1..1, y=1..3, z=8. We check that the count is at most 8 (meaning at least 1 was mined). This is preferred over inventory_has because stained glass does NOT drop itself when broken without Silk Touch — the player gets nothing in inventory. A generous box of ±3 around the wall center is used.

Uses inventory_has because dark oak doors DO drop themselves as an item when broken by hand (unlike glass). The door at (0, 1-2, 10) will drop 1 dark_oak_door item into the player's inventory when either half is broken. This is the most reliable check since the item ends up in inventory.

scene_description: A cleared grassy area with a stone brick structure ~8 blocks ahead of the player. A 3x3 cyan stained glass panel stands at z=5 as a visible landmark. The structure's front wall (z=8) is a 3x3 lime stained glass panel. Inside the structure at z=10, a dark oak door faces south. The player must find the cyan glass landmark, mine through the lime glass wall, then mine the dark oak door inside.
task_text: Find the cyan stained glass landmark ahead of you, then approach the stone brick structure behind it. Mine through the lime stained glass wall at the front of the structure to gain access inside, then mine the dark oak door within.
design_notes: Layout: Player spawns at origin facing +z direction. Cyan glass 3x3 panel at z=5 (columns x=-3 to x=-1, y=1 to y=3). Stone brick structure from z=8 to z=12, side walls at x=-3 and x=3, back wall at z=12, roof at y=5. Front opening at z=8 filled with lime stained glass (x=-1 to x=1, y=1 to y=3 = 9 blocks). Dark oak door at x=0, z=10 facing south inside structure. Area cleared 16x17 blocks to remove biome trees. No tools required — all blocks breakable by hand.
